platform_configuration: CDF/CAL FIRE Marsh Aviation S-2T, 1,200-gallon constant-flow tank

metadata.title: Ground Pattern Performance of the CDF S-2T Turbo Tracker Airtanker
metadata.organization: USDA Forest Service, Missoula Technology and Development Center
metadata.source_pages: 4-5, tables 3 and test-domain text on page 2
metadata.configuration_applicability: Exact Marsh-converted CDF S-2T fleet and tank-system lineage; current tail-level configuration continuity is not established by the public report.
metadata.response_interpretation: Longest measured line length at each coverage level, normalized to a 1,200-gallon load. Flow rates and controller settings are transcribed from table 3.
metadata.simulator_transform: Effective width is inferred by volume conservation at requested coverage; it is not a measured contour width. The transform is limited to coverage levels 0.5 through 6 because the reported longest-contour length collapses at levels 8 and 10, causing a nonphysical increase in uniform-equivalent width. The source rows remain preserved but are not used for rectangular geometry.
metadata.limitations: Controlled flat-ground, low-wind cup-grid tests. Field coverage varies with terrain, wind, weather, and pilot proficiency.
